description: Approximate, reference-led exterior model of the Danxiao RXGJ-12 rotary stick ice-cream machine.
dimensionBasis: The current Danxiao RXGJ-12 product page publishes 5500 x 3750 x 1880 mm. The model uses those dimensions as hard external bounds. An older Made-in-China listing publishes 4900 x 3100 x 2100 mm, so installed revisions may differ.

lineAssignments.note: The approved AI QC floor plan still names RXGJ-6 on both lines. Do not replace that mapping until the factory confirms RXGJ-12 is installed.

references.use: Current identity, isolated product view, installed view, filling detail, 5500 x 3750 x 1880 mm envelope, 12 moulds per row, 140 mould lines, 14,000 pieces per hour, 7.8 tonne weight, station list, and process description.
Close views of radial mould rows, filling nozzles, suction heads, stick insertion, demould pickup, product transfer, and discharge conveyor.
Additional filling-station view, material and component claims, older 4900 x 3100 x 2100 mm envelope, and 10,000 to 12,000 pieces per hour revision data.

references.type: public marketplace video and image gallery
references.use: Confirms the image gallery, RXGJ-12 identity, RUN YU trademark, certification claims, and 12,000-piece-per-hour listing capacity.
Confirms RXGJ-3, RXGJ-6, RXGJ-12, and RXGJ-18 as one rotary stick-machine family.

collectedViews.subject: Isolated front three-quarter machine with tank, stations, outfeed, and control cabinet
Installed front three-quarter view with ring walkway, guard rail, tank services, and raised pickup path
Twelve-nozzle filling manifold, lift cylinder, valves, and mould openings
Manufacturer product examples; product appearance only
Twelve-lane pneumatic manifold and sloped guide detail
Sixteen evenly spaced frames covering filling, suction, stick insertion, and pickup
Sixteen frames covering demould, hanging product transfer, and discharge
Full-resolution ten-second reference frames across the 222-second process video

recognizableFeatures: Low circular stainless body joined by visibly separate inner and outer annular brine decks.
Dense radial mould plate with twelve mould positions per indexed row and a dark central well.
Raised ring walkway with tubular outer guard rail, many short supports, perimeter boxes, pumps, and hoses.
Twelve-wide filling, suction, stick insertion, and demould pickup banks arranged around the carousel.
Tall cylindrical stick hopper with a blue RUN YU / RXGJ-12 band and a shallow conical cap.
Tangential pickup and roller outfeed on the right side, plus a separate stainless HMI cabinet.
Visible blue brine pump, coating vessel, pneumatic lines, red valve handles, and green hanging product samples.

confidence.area: Current catalog envelope, lane count, mould-line count, and maximum capacity
confidence.note: The current manufacturer page publishes these values. The GLB verifier enforces the external envelope and root metadata.

confidence.area: Overall silhouette, major station identity, operator cabinet, walkway, and outfeed form
confidence.note: Two overall manufacturer views and the official process video consistently show these parts.

confidence.area: Relative station position and local proportions
confidence.note: The sources provide one isolated overall angle and one installed angle. Several stations are clear only in close video views.

confidence.area: Exact 140-line carousel pitch, hidden brine geometry, drives, utilities, guarding revision, and installed accessories
confidence.note: The runtime asset uses 48 visible radial sectors for the published 140 indexed lines and keeps hidden mechanisms simple.
Current and older listings publish different envelopes, capacities, power values, and weights. Confirm the installed serial revision before replacing the RXGJ-6 floor-plan mapping.

usage.purpose: QC floor visualization and machine selection
usage.notes: This is a visual floor-plan asset, not a fabrication, installation, process-piping, guarding, cleaning-validation, maintenance, or safety model. Manufacturer photographs remain only in the source reference bundle.
